description: B18 — 卡罗-卡恩古典变例，后翼易位联通双车，再用Rhe1优先占据e列通道。

intro.popup_en: Connecting the Rooks, Lesson 4: After queenside castling, how should the rooks connect, and why should Rhe1 occupy the e-file first?
intro.popup:
链接双车第4课
后翼易位后，双车如何联通，
以及为什么要先用Rhe1占据e列通道。

outro.popup_en: Queenside castling connects the rooks; Rhe1 then occupies the e-file. Establish control of the route before looking for a way to penetrate.
outro.popup:
总结：O-O-O联通双车 → Rhe1占据e列。
先建立通道，准备寻找攻击机会！

moves.popup_en: e4 controls the center and opens lines for White's pieces.
moves.popup:
e4控制中心
开放子力

moves.popup_en: Nxe4! White recaptures the central pawn.
...Bf5! Black develops the bishop actively in the Classical Variation.
moves.popup:
Bf5！黑象主动出动
古典变例结构

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White actively offers an exchange of Black's strong bishop.
Qxd3! The queen recaptures toward the center while keeping the pieces coordinated around the king.
moves.popup:
Qxd3！后回到中心
同时保持王车协调

moves.popup_en: O-O-O! Queenside castling naturally connects White's rooks.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！后翼易位完成！
双车自然联通！

moves.popup_en: Rhe1! The rook from h1 takes the e-file, a highway for future penetration. First occupy the route; there is no need to invade immediately.
moves.popup:
Rhe1！Rh1→e1！
e列就是未来渗透的高速路！
本课先学会占据通道，不急着直接入侵。
